sources.usage: Local source study and adaptation of glTF key interval, endpoint, and duration-scaled tangent conventions; no engine types or copied translation unit. Also inspected skin joint order, optional inverse-bind identity defaults and non-joint ancestor preservation. Morph POSITION/NORMAL/TANGENT relative deltas and tangent handedness were inspected in the same glTF importer.
modifications: Binary search replaces linear key search.
GLM implements vector interpolation, Hermite and shortest-arc quaternion slerp.
Cubic quaternion tracks use component Hermite then normalization, rather than upstream 4.5.1 spherical fallback.
Immutable validated clips, bounded value poses and external unified transport time replace engine resources and animation player.
Retain relative deltas in bounded project values rather than expanded engine blend-shape meshes.
Store up to four immutable targets in RGBA32F vertex textures; morph before linear skinning, then existing twist/taper.
Preserve node-over-mesh default weights and support SCALAR weight animation, including duration-scaled cubic tangents. Fixed-matrix nodes accept weight-only animation.

sources.usage: Direct private calls to existing vcpkg GLM 0.9.9.8#2; no new library.

modifications: Use four normalized influences on immutable secondary vertex streams and per-draw matrix palettes instead of a compute-output vertex buffer.
Convert upstream row-vector convention to project column-vector matrices.
Inverse-transpose blended basis and normalize vertex normals for nonuniform scale; transform tangents and retain handedness.
UNORM8 indices reconstructed in the shader unify D3D11 and GLES float attributes.
Separate ordinary and instanced skin programs; validated 48-bone palette on Windows D3D11 and Adreno 650 GLES.

sources.usage: Local study of position/normal/tangent interpolation; no shader source copied. Its two-buffer compute output and index pairing do not match our glTF relative-target and immutable mesh contracts.
